item.title: FIXTURE NEWS | Date confirmed for Bristol City away clash
item.description: Our away fixture against Bristol City will now take place on Tuesday February 17 at 7:45pm. The original fixture was scheduled to take place on Friday February 13 live on Sky Sports Main Event but was postponed due to both club’s progression in the Emirates FA Cup. All ticket and travel information for the fixture at Ashton Gate will be released to supporters in due course.

item.title: PRE-SEASON | Wrexham AFC to face Wisła Kraków to celebrate Polish club’s 120th anniversary match
item.description: Wrexham AFC will travel to Poland in pre-season to take on Polish 1.Liga leaders Wisła Kraków in a match to celebrate the hosts’ 120th anniversary. Founded in 1906, Wisła Kraków are 13-time Polish champions and were founder members of the Ekstraklasa. The match is provisionally scheduled to take place on July 11, 2026, and is to be played at Synerise Arena Kraków. Full fixture information will be confirmed in due course. item.description: Tickets for our away fixture against Bristol City on Tuesday, February 17th, will go on sale to supporters from 10am on Friday, January 30th. item.title: LOANED OUT | Conor Coady signs for Charlton Athletic on loan
item.description: Wrexham AFC can confirm that defender Conor Coady will join Charlton Athletic on loan until the end of the 2025/26 season. Coady, 32, has made six appearances in total so far this season, and now heads to South-East London for the remainder of the campaign. Nathan Jones’ side sit 19th in the Championship table, as the Addicks aim to secure their Championship status following promotion from League One last season.
